```yaml
name: Eng Common TSP Client Test

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    paths:
      - 'eng/**'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tools/**'
      - '.github/workflows/eng-common-tsp-client-test.yml'
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    paths:
      - 'eng/**'
      - 'src/**'
      - 'tools/**'
      - '.github/workflows/eng-common-tsp-client-test.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test-python-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install black flake8 isort mypy

      - name: Restore dependencies
        run: dotnet restore eng/common/TestProjects/PythonLanguageService.Tests/PythonLanguageService.Tests.csproj

      - name: Run Python Validation Tests
        run: |
          dotnet test eng/common/TestProjects/PythonLanguageService.Tests/PythonLanguageService.Tests.csproj \
            --filter "FullyQualifiedName~PythonLanguageSpecificChecksTests" \
            --logger "console;verbosity=detailed" \
            --no-restore
```
